framing:
This market is asking for delivery craft far more than it is asking for tools. The capabilities it names most often are the ones that show you can run work end to end, not the ones that show you can operate a particular piece of software.

Start with the first project on the list. It closes the largest share of what you are still missing, and it produces something a hiring manager can open rather than a line you have to be believed about.
